title: ericoides glanduliferum
intro: Ericoides glanduliferum, commonly known as  "Golden Button Bush", is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ericoides glanduliferum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
